name: EKeyMode
declaration:

  num2 = 137,
  num3 = 138,
  num4 = 139,
  num5 = 140,
  num6 = 141,
  num7 = 142,
  num8 = 143,
  num9 = 144,
  spot = 145, //spot
  back = 146, // back
  add = 147, // add
  sub = 148, // sub
  enter = 149, // enter
  swap = 150, // swap
  time = 151, // time
  specialEffects = 152, // SpecialEffects

  wisdomShowNext = 172, //"切换下一个",
